text: {"lessons":["Selling winners brought satisfaction, but those trades alone do not show that I improved my long-term outcome; I should judge decisions by my plan, not by whether I locked in a gain.","My account value moved up and down even during months when I did nothing, reminding me that short-term fluctuations are not reasons by themselves to trade.","Before adding to positions or selling shares, I should check how each choice affects my overall allocation and keep enough cash to preserve flexibility."]}
